subject.title: fix: preserve Feishu post line breaks

question: Should maintainers provide exact-head live Feishu proof for this more comprehensive branch and make it canonical, or select the already proof-positive implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 and port any missing edge-case fixes there?
rationale: The contributor cannot access an approved Feishu tenant, while automation cannot determine whether the sibling's screenshot proof covers this branch's additional chunking, code-block, and edit-path behavior.

options.title: Prove this branch
options.body: Run an exact-head Feishu send and reply scenario covering prose line breaks, fenced Markdown, and multi-post chunking, then resolve the failed checks and use this branch as the canonical candidate.

options.title: Adopt the proven sibling
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 only after comparing and porting any required quoted-code, indented-code, Markdown-chunking, and edit-limit protections from this PR.

options.title: Pause the cluster
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and close competing branches only after maintainers define the minimum supported Markdown and chunking contract.

recommendation.title: Prove this branch
recommendation.body: Run an exact-head Feishu send and reply scenario covering prose line breaks, fenced Markdown, and multi-post chunking, then resolve the failed checks and use this branch as the canonical candidate.
